instruction: At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Thanks <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.

from pprint import pprint

pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='todoist'][0]
access_token=apis.todoist.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

# tasks of interest assigned to Paul incomplete
paul_email='paul_mill@gmail.com'

# comments fetched earlier are not persisted, so re-fetch quickly for the four tasks we think will be reassigned
eligible_task_ids=[2851,2854,2861,2886]

def fetch_comments(task_id):
    comments=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.todoist.show_task_comments(access_token=access_token, task_id=task_id, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        comments.extend(resp)
        if len(resp) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    return comments

all_actions=[]

for tid in eligible_task_ids:
    task=apis.todoist.show_task(task_id=tid, access_token=access_token)
    comments=fetch_comments(tid)
    # find agreeing comments from non-Paul authors
    agreeing=[]
    for c in comments:
        author_email=c['user']['email']
        content=c['content']
        if author_email.lower()==paul_email.lower():
            continue
        # exclude explicit refusal
        refusal_markers=['Sorry','sorry','cannot','Cannot','busy','refuse','I cannot']
        # agree markers
        agree_markers=['Sure','sure','I can take','I can take this task','can take','bandwidth','I have the bandwidth','I can take this','I can take this task']
        is_refusal=any(m in content for m in refusal_markers)
        is_agree=any(m in content for m in agree_markers)
        # also if content has 'take this task' and not refusal
        if ('take this task' in content.lower()) and not is_refusal:
            is_agree=True
        if is_agree and not is_refusal:
            agreeing.append(c)
    print('task', tid, task['title'], 'num_comments', len(comments), 'num_agreeing', len(agreeing))
    if agreeing:
        # pick first agreeing comment by created_at order as returned
        chosen=agreeing[0]
        first_name=chosen['user']['name'].split()[0]
        all_actions.append({
            'task_id': tid,
            'title': task['title'],
            'assignee_email': chosen['user']['email'],
            'assignee_first_name': first_name,
            'agree_comment': chosen['content']
        })

print('\nActions to perform:')
for a in all_actions:
    print(a)

# Verification table
print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE (task_id | title | reassignee_email | comment_snippet)')
for a in all_actions:
    snippet=a['agree_comment'].replace('\n',' ')[:80]
    print(a['task_id'], '|', a['title'], '|', a['assignee_email'], '|', snippet)

print('total_actions', len(all_actions))

from datetime import datetime

pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='todoist'][0]
access_token=apis.todoist.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

paul_email='paul_mill@gmail.com'

# Candidate tasks and agreeing commenters derived from earlier comment scan
planned_task_to_commenter={
    2851: {'target_email':'angelica.wils@gmail.com', 'expected_first_name':'Angelica'},
    2854: {'target_email':'matthew.blac@gmail.com', 'expected_first_name':'Matthew'},
    2861: {'target_email':'siwhit@gmail.com', 'expected_first_name':'Sierra'},
    2886: {'target_email':'kathrynmaldonado@gmail.com', 'expected_first_name':'Kathryn'},
}

# Helper: fetch all comments for task (paginated)
def fetch_comments(task_id):
    comments=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.todoist.show_task_comments(access_token=access_token, task_id=task_id, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        comments.extend(resp)
        if len(resp) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    return comments

# Build and verify action payloads
action_items=[]
for tid, meta in planned_task_to_commenter.items():
    task=apis.todoist.show_task(task_id=tid, access_token=access_token)
    comments=fetch_comments(tid)

    # Find agreeing commenter match by exact email and not Paul
    target_email=meta['target_email']
    agreeing=[c for c in comments if c['user']['email'].lower()==target_email.lower() and c['user']['email'].lower()!=paul_email.lower()]
    # choose most recent/first as returned order
    if not agreeing:
        raise RuntimeError(f'No comment found from target email for task {tid}')
    chosen=agreeing[0]

    target_first_name=chosen['user']['name'].split()[0]
    # Check expected
    print('TASK', tid, 'title', task['title'])
    print(' current assignee', task['assignee']['email'], 'is_completed', task['is_completed'])
    print(' target commenter', chosen['user']['name'], chosen['user']['email'], 'chosen_comment_snippet', chosen['content'][:60].replace('\n',' '))
    print(' expected_first_name', meta['expected_first_name'], 'target_first_name', target_first_name)

    thanks_content=f"Thanks {target_first_name}!"
    thanks_exists=any(c['content'].strip()==thanks_content for c in comments)

    action_items.append({
        'task_id': tid,
